scope: Independent review of frozen emulator controller-loss evidence; not real-AZ acceptance
observations: Guest partitions and mounts retain only native sda/sda1 among USB storage devices.
QMP still reports a running emulator and attached virtual USB devices; that does not prove guest controller or storage health.
The settled source log records all five private sources absent and releases their aliases before mode 1/epoch 2 completion.
The Off capture occurs after controller loss and therefore supports cached-source privacy, not fresh attached-source privacy.
conclusion: The zero-source On state cannot establish a mode-recovery defect because its backing devices had already disconnected. No mod recovery change is justified by this evidence.
remaining: Repeat the mode/source matrix with healthy guest storage and record guest partitions, topology, mounts and controller errors around each functional block.
Investigate the separate missing player7/slot7 and player8/slot7 startup rows, which precede controller loss.
A host-only alternative USB controller fixture requires actual kernel-driver support and preserved native/hub topology checks.
